sections.title: The person on the throne still holds a leafy wand

The figure sits sideways on a stone throne, facing left. Beneath a gold crown is a red head covering. A red robe is combined with green fabric across the shoulders and a cloak patterned with black lizard-like forms. One hand holds a leafy wand resting upright on the ground; the other rests on the knee.

sections.bodyMarkdown:
Waite describes the King of Wands as ardent, animated and passionate, and explicitly mentions the lion on the throne. His upright terms emphasize honesty and conscientiousness. Reversed, severity appears alongside tolerance, so the historical interpretation is not a simple switch from good to bad.

sections.title: Reading it upright
sections.bodyMarkdown:

sections.title: In everyday life
sections.bodyMarkdown:
### Leading a new joint project

Explain the goal and criteria for success, then invite people to identify constraints in time, technology or resources. Bringing differences into the plan is more responsible than asking everyone to overcome them alone during delivery.

### Organizing a trip with friends

You can take the initiative in gathering options while letting everyone confirm budget, timing and willingness to join. Being good at arranging things does not authorize deciding for everyone or treating different needs as spoiling the fun.

### Setting your own long-term direction

Choose a goal you can keep testing, separating near-term steps from what you will not do yet. Direction offers stability while methods can change with feedback. Loyalty to the original plan need not mean ignoring new facts.

articleMarkdown:
# King of Wands: Take responsibility for the direction

Card: King of Wands  
Card marking: K  
Minor Arcana · Wands  
Keywords: Direction · Responsibility · Leadership

## At a glance

Upright: You see a direction, take the lead and are willing to answer for your choices

Reversed: You push people to keep up without enough room for discussion or adjustment

The King of Wands has reached the throne, but the wand in hand still grows leaves. Position has not removed the theme of action. It takes the question further: when your decisions affect others, how does enthusiasm become responsibility?

## The person on the throne still holds a leafy wand

The figure sits sideways on a stone throne, facing left. Beneath a gold crown is a red head covering. A red robe is combined with green fabric across the shoulders and a cloak patterned with black lizard-like forms. One hand holds a leafy wand resting upright on the ground; the other rests on the knee.

Lions and lizard-like motifs decorate the tall throne back, and a small reptile stands on the platform near the feet. Blue sky and a little barren ground remain visible. Looking beyond the frame may suggest outward attention, but there are no subjects, troops or orders being carried out. A crown alone does not supply that story.

## Historical descriptions of vitality and conscientiousness

Waite describes the King of Wands as ardent, animated and passionate, and explicitly mentions the lion on the throne. His upright terms emphasize honesty and conscientiousness. Reversed, severity appears alongside tolerance, so the historical interpretation is not a simple switch from good to bad.

Using those clues as background, this article develops the King into a contemporary role concerned with direction and influence. It does not retain the old text’s identification of people by appearance, gender and marital status. Nor can a card vouch for a real person’s honesty.

## Reading it upright

Upright, the card can ask you to organize enthusiasm into a direction others can understand. Explain not only what you hope to achieve, but why it is worth doing, what comes first at this stage and what will not be done yet. A clear direction lets collaborators exercise judgment instead of awaiting instructions at every turn.

Responsibility includes acknowledging the costs of decisions. If a plan you promote affects other people’s time and work, you need to hear relevant information, provide resources and take responsibility for explaining and rearranging things when circumstances change. Leadership can happen in a family, community or small project without a formal title.

## Reading it reversed

Here, reversal checks whether leading has become one-way demand. You may have thought far ahead without explaining your assumptions to those beside you. Or you may interpret every objection as a lack of enthusiasm, leaving important limitations unspoken. The greater an action’s impact, the more it needs room for challenge and correction.

Another problem is a grand direction without specific owners or resources behind the promises. Reduce the scope and turn expectations into workable arrangements rather than simply rallying everyone again. When a decision proves mistaken, explaining the change is more reliable than maintaining an image of always being right.

## In everyday life

### Leading a new joint project

Explain the goal and criteria for success, then invite people to identify constraints in time, technology or resources. Bringing differences into the plan is more responsible than asking everyone to overcome them alone during delivery.

### Organizing a trip with friends

You can take the initiative in gathering options while letting everyone confirm budget, timing and willingness to join. Being good at arranging things does not authorize deciding for everyone or treating different needs as spoiling the fun.

### Setting your own long-term direction

Choose a goal you can keep testing, separating near-term steps from what you will not do yet. Direction offers stability while methods can change with feedback. Loyalty to the original plan need not mean ignoring new facts.

## A short exercise

For something you are leading, write four sentences: where we are going, what we will do first, what each person can decide and what evidence would prompt a change. Ask someone affected to explain it back and check whether your understandings match.

## Common misreadings

The King of Wands does not necessarily mean a boss, married man or entrepreneur, and forcefulness alone is not leadership. The card can support learning about direction and responsibility. Whether someone is trustworthy still depends on consistent behaviour and how they fulfil their responsibilities.

## Artwork and English sources

- [A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, Part III §2, King of Wands (1911-labelled English transcription)](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktwaki.htm)

sourceRecord.title: 权杖国王 为方向承担责任
sourceRecord.uprightQuickTake: 看准方向，能带头行动也愿意负责
sourceRecord.reversedQuickTake: 急着让别人跟上，却没留出讨论和调整空间
sourceRecord.hook: 权杖国王已经坐上王座，手里的木杖仍然长着叶子。地位没有让行动的主题消失，只是把问题推得更远：当别人受到你的决定影响，热情怎样变成责任？
imageReading: 人物侧身坐在石制王座上，面朝画面左侧。头戴金色王冠，冠下有红色头罩，身穿红袍，肩上披着绿色衣料与带黑色蜥蜴状纹样的披风。一手握着竖立在地面的生叶长杖，另一手放在膝上。
高大的椅背绘有狮子和蜥蜴状图案，脚前平台上也有一只小型爬行动物。背景保留蓝色天空与少量荒地。视线朝向画外，让人容易联想到对外关注；但图像没有画出臣属、军队或正在执行的命令，不能仅凭王冠补出统治情节。
tradition: Waite 把权杖国王描述为热烈、充满活力、有激情的人，并明确提到王座上的狮子符号。他的正位词条强调诚实与有责任心，逆位则出现严厉而仍有宽容的组合，历史解释并不只是简单的好坏翻转。
本篇以这些线索为背景，将国王发展为承担方向与影响的现代角色。旧书按外貌、性别和婚姻状况指人的方式不予沿用，诚实也不能由一张牌替某个现实人物作担保。
uprightMeaning: 正位可以提醒你把热情组织成别人能够理解的方向。不只是说想实现什么，还要说明为什么值得做、这一阶段先做什么，以及哪些事情暂时不做。方向清楚，合作的人才知道怎样运用自己的判断，而不是处处等待指令。
担当也包括承认决定的代价。自己推动的计划若影响他人的时间与工作，就需要听取相关信息、给出资源，并在变化发生时承担重新解释和安排的责任。带领可以发生在家庭、社群或小项目里，并不需要正式头衔。
reversedMeaning: 逆位在这里用来检查主导是否变成单向要求。可能自己已经想得很远，却没有让同行者了解前提；也可能把反对意见都当成缺乏热情，导致重要限制无人敢说。行动越有影响，越需要可被质疑和修正。
另一个问题是方向宏大，承诺却没有具体负责人和资源。此时需要缩小范围，把期望改成可执行的安排，而不只是再次动员大家。若决定出了偏差，说明调整原因，比维持自己永远正确的形象更可靠。

situations.title: 带一个新的合作项目
situations.text: 先解释目标与成功标准，再邀请成员指出时间、技术或资源限制。把分歧带进计划，比在执行后要求大家自行克服更负责任。

situations.title: 组织朋友共同出行
situations.text: 可以主动整理选项，但要让每个人确认预算、时间与参与意愿。善于安排并不意味着可以替所有人决定，也不能把不同需求当作扫兴。

situations.title: 给自己定长期方向
situations.text: 选一个可以持续检验的目标，分出近期步骤与暂时不做的事。方向提供稳定性，方法仍可随着反馈改变；不需要为了坚持原计划而忽视新事实。

sourceRecord.practice: 为正在主导的一件事写四句话：我们要去哪里、这一阶段先做什么、每个人能决定什么、出现何种证据就调整。请一位受影响的人复述，看看双方是否理解一致。
sourceRecord.commonMisread: 权杖国王不一定是上司、已婚男性或创业者，也不意味着强势就是有领导力。这张牌可以用来学习方向与担当，现实人物是否可信，仍应看持续的行为与责任落实。
sourceRecord.sourceClaim: Waite 的热烈活力、王座狮子、诚实责任心及逆位严厉而宽容。方向解释、授权与影响责任为原创现代教学。
sourceRecord.imageReadingTitle: 王座上的人仍握着生叶木杖
sourceRecord.traditionTitle: 活力与责任心的历史描述
sourceRecord.readingApproach: 图像可见事实、Waite 历史解释与原创现代反思分别标示；正逆位是学习与自我反思提示，不用来确认未来、健康或他人隐秘行为。
sourceRecord.reverseMethod: 当代反思式读法，依据主题的受阻、失衡、过度或需要重新安排展开；不是对 Waite 旧逆位词条逐项翻译。
